question: Which of the following sentences contains the ANTONYM of the word ‘ignore’ ?

options.text: Avoid foods which make you sick.
He did not succeed in gaining custody of his daughter.
To keep a tidy kitchen, do not neglect washing your dishes.
Ritika recognised Kavita in the gathering.

solution:
The correct answer is** Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"ignore"** means to deliberately pay no attention to something. (अनदेखा करना)

 
 
• **Example:** She chose to** ignore **the criticism and continued with her work.
 
 
 
• **"Recognise"** refers to identifying or acknowledging the existence or validity of something. (पहचानना)
 
 
• **Example:** Ritika **recognised** Kavita in the gathering.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'ignore'** is **'recognise'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Avoid** (बचना): To keep away from or stop oneself from doing something.

 
 
• **Example: Avoid** foods which make you sick.
 
 
 
• **Succeed** (सफल होना): Achieve the desired aim or result.
 
 
• **Example:** He did not** succeed** in gaining custody of his daughter.
 
 
 
• **Neglect** (उपेक्षा करना): Fail to care for properly.
 
 
• **Example:** To keep a tidy kitchen, do not **neglect** washing your dishes.
